question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Noticeable
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Noticeable"** means something that is easily seen or noticed; clear or apparent. (ध्यान देने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **There was a **noticeable** improvement in her performance after the training.
 
 
 
• **"Hidden"** refers to something that is concealed or not easily found or seen. (छिपा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The **hidden **treasure was found after years of searching.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'noticeable' **is **'hidden'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hail **(अभिवादन करना): To greet or acclaim enthusiastically.

 
 
• **Example:** The crowd** hailed** the victorious team as they entered the stadium.
 
 
 
• **Taunt **(ताना मारना): To provoke or challenge someone with insulting remarks.
 
 
• **Example: **He **taunted** his opponent throughout the match.
 
 
 
• **Dignified** (गरिमामय): Having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect.
 
 
• **Example:** She maintained a** dignified** silence during the argument.
